narrative:
Material PL3__MCCFF617 exhibits lumpy demand with high variability (CV=1.80) and 27.8% non-zero days. 
A significant downward trend is detected (p=0.0009). Lead time is volatile (CV=0.85, mean=1.24 days).

The recommended policy increases safety stock from 0 to 8 units to achieve 95% service level, 
translating to a safety lead time of 3.87 days (vs. SAP's 0.00 days). 
Order quantity remains at MOQ (455 units) as EOQ (244) is below MOQ.

The optimized policy increases total annual cost by $10.83 (2.7%), 
but provides significantly better stockout protection. Storage capacity is adequate (463/1321 units used).

Primary risk factor is demand variability (78.3% of variance), not supplier lead time variability (21.7%). 
Given the lumpy pattern, consider implementing a (R,s,S) policy or periodic review with higher service targets for business-critical periods.
